subject: Service disruption - commercial makewhole offer and contract amendment
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@newtonanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@newtonanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: throughput spike + errors impacting production

Ava,

We experienced a sharp throughput drop and increased 5xx rates during our morning peak window (07-Aug, 08:15–09:05 PDT). End-users are seeing timeouts and retries, and several downstream pipelines are backing up. Attached is a slice of telemetry and a short timeline from our side.

This is customer-impacting and procurement is asking for clarity on remediation and any commercial remedies (credits or makewhole options). We need an initial remediation timeline and an estimate for credit calculation no later than EOD PDT today.

Please escalate. I can make time for a call at 10:30 if helpful.

Thanks,
Karen
Head of Platform Engineering
Newton Analytics

Attachments: usage_telemetry_0707-0708.csv
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@newtonanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: throughput spike + errors impacting production

Karen — thank you for the heads up and sorry for the customer impact. We’ve already opened an incident (INC-20270807-12) and our on-call SREs are collecting traces.

Immediate actions we’ve kicked off:
- Rolling back a recent routing tweak that correlated with metric uptick (in progress)
- Isolating the affected pool and shifting traffic to warm spare capacity
- Increasing autoscaling headroom for Newton’s cluster for the next 12 hours

I’m scheduling a 30-min sync at 10:30 PDT; invite sent. We’ll bring an operational timeline and a preliminary credit calculation by EOD.

I’ve attached a short incident summary for your procurement team to preview.

Ava Chen
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0110

Attachments: incident_summary_20270807.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: quick root-cause readout + commercial options

Notes from post-mortem grab:
- Root cause: a routing policy regression that increased tail latency for requests with long prompt contexts; under contention the KV cache pressure led to higher CPU stalls and a rise in 502/504s.
- Impact window: 08:12–08:58 PDT (peak at 08:30).
- Customers affected: Newton Analytics (high throughput job), a handful of smaller tenants in same pool.

Commercial options to propose to the customer (draft):
1) Credits: Pro-rated service credit for 45 days (applied to monthly usage), plus a targeted one-time service credit equal to X% of last month’s invoice to approximate the makewhole.
2) Cash makewhole: one-time payment (exec sign-off required) to cover verified business impact up to a capped amount.
3) Product remediation + SLA amendment: include an explicit availability definition for their high-throughput profile and guaranteed ops runbook/priority queueing at no extra charge for 6 months.

Attachments: proposed_contract_amendment_redwood_v1.docx (contains amended SLA language and runbook summary).

Markus
VP, Reliability
From: Karen Li <karen.li@newtonanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@newtonanalytics.com>, Ashok Patel <ashok@datalane.io>
Date: 2027-08-08T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: throughput spike + errors impacting production

Appreciate the quick investigation and the draft options. Procurement is pushing back on credits only — they prefer a one-time commercial makewhole if we can substantiate the impact quickly. They’ve asked for:
- A clear, itemized credit vs cash proposal (numbers)
- The full proposed amendment with DocuSign-ready text (procurement lawyers will redline)
- Exec confirmation that this is an exceptional remediation and a timeline for preventing recurrence

Can you provide dollar-equivalent figures for the makewhole by EOD tomorrow? If you can route the amendment via DocuSign that will speed things.

Karen
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@newtonanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: throughput spike + errors impacting production

Karen — following internal approvals (Rishi signed off for commercial uplift) we can offer the following two options for Newton to choose from:

Option A — Service-credit focused (no cash):
- 60% pro-rated service credit applied to the August invoice (covers the impact window + margin for downstream retries)
- Additional 30 days of priority-runbook support and accelerated on-call routing for your high-throughput jobs

Option B — One-time makewhole payment + SLA commitment:
- One-time cash makewhole payment of $60,000 (paid within 30 days after acceptance and verification)
- Contract amendment to add a high-throughput availability SLA (99.95% for pinned pools) and a 6-month trial of priority queuing at no additional cost

Next steps:
- If Option A: we’ll apply credits immediately and confirm by email.
- If Option B: we’ll send a DocuSign package with the amendment (proposed_contract_amendment_redwood_v1.docx attached) and an MOA for the payment.

We can also do a hybrid if procurement prefers partial cash and partial credit. Please let me know the preferred path by EOD tomorrow so we can route approvals.

Best,
Ava

Attachments: proposed_contract_amendment_redwood_v1.docx
From: Karen Li <karen.li@newtonanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@newtonanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: throughput spike + errors impacting production

Ava — thank you. Procurement discussed with execs and Newton will accept Option B (one-time makewhole payment + SLA amendment) subject to minor legal redlines on the amendment. Please route DocuSign to procurement@newtonanalytics.com and copy our legal team. We’ll review and return redlines within 48 hours.

Appreciate the expedited response and the priority support commitment; looking forward to the amendment.

Karen
Head of Platform Engineering
Newton Analytics
